messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up  enterprise asks for region locks + APAC latency SLO. Need compact plan for roadmap.
Priya (Arch): Two-phase approach works: Phase 1 = policy templates + soft-affinity; Phase 2 = hard residency lanes with reservations.
Rafi (Eng): Soft-affinity is quick: policy flags + per-tenant feature flag. Hard lanes need admission controller and billing changes.
Liam (SRE): Ops: hard lanes raise cold-start/failover risk. Require evacuation playbook and regional chaos tests.
Omar (Sales): Customers want names/pricing. I'll avoid "no-egress" until Legal confirms. Can offer "Residency Pilot (soft)".
Zoe (Legal): We need explicit fallback language in contracts. Absolute no-egress requires KMS-in-region + attestation.
Maya (PM): Proposed Q2: templates, simulator, soft-affinity pilot. Q3: reservation pilot + migration tool. Action owners?
Rafi (Eng): I'll spike DSL + dry-run API (1 week).
Priya (Arch): I'll draft templates + telemetry spec (3 days).
Liam (SRE): I'll prepare ops runbook + chaos plan (2 weeks).
Omar (Sales): I'll line up two pilots and draft pricing options.
Zoe (Legal): I'll review pilot T&Cs within 3 days.
ops-bot: Reminder: add roadmap PR link to #release-war-room by EOD Fri. :bell:
